title: Ragefire Chasm
body: Ragefire Chasm is a network of volcanic caverns beneath Orgrimmar, entered from the Cleft of Shadow in the heart of the city. Lava lights its tunnels, and the rock itself seems to stir: molten elementals walk the burning paths, and earthborers, burrowing worms, gnaw through the stone. In the lower caves the troggs of Ragefire swarm with their shamans, and off the main way their chieftain Oggleflint keeps a cave of his own. Beyond them the halls belong to the Searing Blade. Orc cultists, shield-bearing enforcers and warlocks with voidwalkers at their heels hold the deeper caverns, and in the midst of a lake of lava stands a felguard of great size, Taragaman the Hungerer. Further on, the cult's warlocks hold the deepest halls, and a satyr walks a high walkway overhead. Few come down here unbidden. Neeru Fireblade sends some, the Undercity others, and the tauren of Thunder Bluff have their own reasons.

parts.body: Deep in the cult's halls, the Searing Blade keeps an orb brimming with blood, and it is less still than it looks. When one who had come seeking that blood laid hands on the orb, a demon of the doomguard kind came forth from it into the chasm: Zelemar the Wrathful. He never left the caverns. He was slain there, far beneath the city.

title: Taragaman the Hungerer
body: Taragaman the Hungerer is a felguard, a demon of the Burning Legion, and he towers over the cultists of the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm. His place is in the midst of a lake of lava in the cult's halls, where the fire gives him light and the cultists gather on the stone around him. He is armored like a warrior of the Legion and bears a massive two-handed sword. How a demon of his kind came to the caverns beneath the Horde's own capital, nothing in the chasm says.

parts.body: In the Cleft of Shadow, Neeru Fireblade names the felguard the leader of the Searing Blade. Above all, he says, the Warchief charged him with rooting out whatever brings demonic taint into the city. The Burning Blade is one such threat but not the only one, and the Searing Blade must be stopped as well. For that, its leader must die.
sources: quest 5761 description (the primary task set upon me by our great Warchief: root out the creatures responsible for infesting the city with demonic influence; the Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm, subverting innocent members of the Horde; their leader must be slain, a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer; his heart will appease Thrall)
orgrimmar.json 163704 and 163710 (the cult leading Horde members astray, the heart for Thrall), not retold

parts.body: Taragaman met his attackers with brute strength and fire. His uppercuts flung them back across the stone, and again and again flame burst from him in a ring that seared everyone near. For all his size and fury, the felguard fell in the midst of his burning lake.
sources: smart_scripts 11520 base: Uppercut 18072 on the victim, Fire Nova 11970 on himself; module (dungeon_ragefire_chasm.sql): the same two spells, retimed (Spell.dbc: Uppercut knocks the target back; Fire Nova inflicts Fire damage to nearby enemies)

parts.body: The felguard's heart went up out of the chasm to Neeru Fireblade's hut. Neeru greeted it with a bark of triumph, certain the Warchief would be delighted. He took charge of the heart himself, promising that it would be dealt with as it should be, and sent its bearer off to enjoy the victory while he carried word of it to Thrall.

title: Oggleflint
body: Oggleflint is the Ragefire Chieftain, lord of the troggs who swarm through the lower caves of Ragefire Chasm. He is bigger than the troggs and shamans around him, a squat brute of stone-grey hide, and he keeps to a cave of his own off the main way through the caverns. A great bone serves him for a club. Whatever the troggs of Ragefire want in the depths beneath Orgrimmar, it is Oggleflint they follow.

parts.body: Oggleflint fought like the brute he was. Each sweep of his bone club cleaved through whoever stood before him and into the one beside them as well. It was not enough. The chieftain fell in his own cave, and the troggs of Ragefire were left without him.

title: The Power to Destroy
body: In the caverns below Orgrimmar, a sect of the Shadow Council has taken root: the Searing Blade. Its cultists hold two books of spells, Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether, and word of them has reached the Royal Quarter of the Undercity, which wants them out of the sect's hands. Someone must go down into the Searing Blade's halls beneath the Horde's capital, take both books from the cultists who keep them, and carry them back across the sea to the Undercity.

parts.body: Varimathras explains it in the Dark Lady's terms. The Legion's servants are generous with gifts to those who follow them, and the Lady judges that some of those gifts would serve better in her keeping than with followers of narrower sight. The Searing Blade's two books are such gifts. She means to borrow them, the dreadlord says, and the task of fetching them falls to whoever stands before him.
sources: quest 5725 description (many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers; some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with lesser vision; the Searing Blade a prime example; she would like to borrow these books; you will get them for her); creature_queststarter 2425 Varimathras; reachable only with mod-individual-progression (Varimathras spawned in phase II, zone_undercity.sql)

parts.body: Varimathras received the books with approval. Serving the Dark Lady so well, he said, showed a persistence and ambition her people could put to good use. He bade the bearer return to him in time, for there might be more work, all of it to help the Lady in her struggle to overthrow the Lich King and set the Scourge wholly free.
sources: quest 5725 reward text (you have done well in serving the Dark Lady; your continued perseverance and ambition will be of great use to the Lady's subjects; return to me again; other tasks that will aid the Dark Lady in her attempts at overtaking the Lich King and completely freeing the Scourge); creature_questender 2425

parts.body: In the Royal Quarter, Bragor Bloodfist wanted the books in his own hands. The trouble was Orgrimmar's, he said, but the Searing Blade is made up mostly of orcs, and he would not trust a matter so delicate to the grunts of that city. Once both books reached him he vowed to keep them well hidden, for a Shadow Council grown strong again was the last thing anyone needed.
sources: quest 14356 description (Orgrimmar's got a problem; they're mainly orcs, and I can't trust sensitive information in the hands of the grunts there; kept out of the hands of the Searing Blade and the Forsaken alike; bring them to me directly) and reward text (I'll keep these safe from prying eyes; the last thing we need is a strong Shadow Council rising up again); creature_questender 36273 Bragor Bloodfist
